sources.title: markrodrigo/Qwen-3.5-0.8B-Spatial-SQL-1.1 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model, Qwen-3.5-.8B-Spatial-SQL-1.1, is a 0.8B, narrow use case, text to spatial SQL, lightly fine-tuned model. In general, its primary use case is the Natural Language command adaptation of particular geographic spatial functions as normally defined in pure SQL.
